summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. (TSX/NASDAQ: AYA) filed a Form 6-K announcing its acquisition of a strategic exploration portfolio in Morocco, comprising three mining licenses and 18 exploration permits totaling approximately 259 km² across three projects (Zagora, Agadir-Melloul, Goulmim). No purchase price, stake percentage, or advisor was disclosed. The acquisition expands Aya's Moroccan land package from ~732 km² to over 991 km², a 35.4% increase. Management highlighted the deal as reinforcing first-mover advantage and district-scale exploration strategy. Watch for closing conditions and potential permitting or regulatory approvals in Morocco.
